title: Fine-Grained Chinese Hate Speech Understanding: Span-Level Resources, Coded Term Lexicon, and Enhanced Detection Frameworks

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs on their ability to perform span-level extraction of hate speech quadruples (target, argument, hatefulness, group) and identifying/explaining coded sexist terms and slang using hard/soft F1 matching and LLM-as-a-judge.

Evaluating LLMs on their ability to perform span-level extraction of hate speech quadruples and identifying/explaining coded racist terms, including phono-graphemic variations and implicit semantic slurs.

Evaluating LLMs on their ability to perform span-level extraction of hate speech quadruples and identifying/explaining coded terms and implicit expressions targeting specific regional populations in China.
Evaluating LLMs on their ability to perform span-level extraction of hate speech quadruples and identifying/explaining coded anti-LGBTQ terms and phonetic variations.
